own_solution.law: Static equilibrium with Archimedes' principle: T = (rho_liquid - rho_cube) * V * g
assumptions: cube fully submerged and at rest

TCBBB.regime: string intact: tension below the 50 N breaking load

T13C2.regime: string intact: tension below the 50 N limit

notes: Base: T = (1000 - 600)(1.0e-3)(9.8) = 3.92 N. With liquid of 1250 kg/m^3 in this tank: T = 650 x 1.0e-3 x 9.8 = 6.37 N. Depth of the top face enters the pressure on top and bottom faces (rho g d and rho g (d + a)), but the difference rho g a A is depth-independent, so the depth cancels (C); both depth sentences state 50 cm. String-strength sentences both state 50 N; the tension (3.92 N, or 6.37 N even in the denser liquid) is well below 50 N, so K. 'Earlier experiment' and 'second tank' sentences do not alter the present system (D). The numeral-free sentences (TB60F, T5B30) carry no number by construction and are not compared numerically.
